narration.reasoning: The transaction is executed via the Safe's execTransaction (c0, c1), which verifies two owner signatures via ecrecover (c2, c3), increments the Safe's nonce from 1 to 2 (s1), and emits ExecutionSuccess (e0). The Safe then calls approve on the USDC proxy contract (c4), which delegatecalls to its implementation (c5) to set the USDC allowance from the Safe to Ravi (0x2C81904f370e7f6490aEa328CA847AEFdc3853D3) to 2,500,000,000 base units (2,500 USDC), updating storage slot s0 and emitting the Approval event (e1). No token or ETH balances change.

effects.sentence: The Safe approves Ravi to spend up to 2,500 USDC on its behalf.
The Safe increments its transaction nonce from 1 to 2 and records successful execution.
